AES-256-GCM + Argon2id
How your text is protected

Encryption you can inspect

AES-256-GCM encrypts the text and detects tampering. Argon2id derives a 256-bit key from your password, using 64 MiB of memory, 3 passes, and 4 lanes. Every encryption uses a fresh random salt and nonce.

Private by design

Files are read locally. No analytics, cookies, browser storage, or external scripts. Clear session removes the current text and result from the interface.

Keep your password safe

Use several randomly chosen words or a password manager. There is no reset or recovery. Use a trusted browser and device: extensions, malware, or a compromised app server could access text while you use the app. This app has not had an independent security audit.
